title: A member launches their own business page with a few questions and Vera, laid out like every Space

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread: simplify the business seed from the admin into something simple enough for an iOS experience, with great writing prompts and AI that launches the page fully arranged to the standard Space.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. /spaces/launch is the owner-facing front door onto the Business Seeder pipeline (intake mode 'owner', which the store already modeled and nothing used). Eight plain questions, one per screen on the Spark shell, each with a writing prompt and a tap-to-fill example; only the name is required. The answers fold into the same labeled paste the staff form builds, the durable research job and the AI page composer draft the page, the member looks it over, and Launch applies it with the member as owner (isDemo false) and hands them to the setup walk. Guards: AI master switch (falls back to the Create a Space wizard), the same Space cap createSpace enforces, three launches a day per member, intake reads bound to its creator. First-party tracking only (owner_launch_start, owner_launch_done), no answer text. The staff console is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const l=fs.readFileSync('lib/importer/launch.ts','utf8');const a=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/launch/actions.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/isDemo: false, ownerConfirmed: true/.test(l))bad.push('launch is not the owner own consent');if(!/mode: 'owner'/.test(a))bad.push('intake is not owner mode');if(!/aiEnabled\(\)/.test(a))bad.push('AI master switch not checked');if(!/spaceCreationBlockReason/.test(a))bad.push('Space cap not enforced');if(!/rateLimitOk\('owner_launch'/.test(a))bad.push('no daily cap');if(!/row\.createdBy !== profileId/.test(a))bad.push('intake not bound to its owner');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1213: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the owner launch loses a guard: owner consent, owner mode, the AI switch, the Space cap, the daily cap or the owner binding.
